# XAA Hackathon Kit (v3)

> A spec-first prompt kit for building a Cross-App Access (XAA)
> Requesting App against the public xaa.dev playground — in any
> language or framework. Two protocol paths (OIDC + PKCE, or SAML 2.0
> Web Browser SSO) converging on an IdP refresh token as the session
> anchor, then RFC 8693 token exchange to an ID-JAG, RFC 7523
> jwt-bearer to an access token, and RFC 6750 bearer error mapping.

The kit at `hackathon-kit/` is the authoritative spec. AI coding agents
should start at `hackathon-kit/IGNITION.md`. The three target hosts are
fixed: `https://idp.xaa.dev`, `https://auth.resource.xaa.dev`,
`https://api.resource.xaa.dev`.

Two things define v3 and are easy to get wrong from prior knowledge:

1. **The IdP refresh token is the session anchor**, requested via
   `offline_access` and presented as `subject_token` (type
   `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:refresh_token`) on every ID-JAG
   exchange. The ID Token lives ~10 minutes and is *not* the anchor.
   The resource authorization server issues **no** refresh token, by
   design.
2. **Two login paths.** OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE) or SAML 2.0
   (SP-initiated SSO, then an extra Step 0b exchanging the assertion for
   a refresh token). They diverge only at Step 0/0b; everything from
   Step 1 onward is identical.

Note the kit's step numbering is offset by one from xaa.dev's own docs —
this kit's Step 1 is their "Step 2". Mapping table in
`hackathon-kit/reference/xaa-spec.md`.

## Entry points

- [IGNITION.md](hackathon-kit/IGNITION.md): Paste-into-agent runbook for Codex / Claude Code / Cursor / Aider with filesystem access. Opens with the protocol gate.
- [Chat-only ignition](hackathon-kit/ignition/chat-only.md): Copy-paste ignition flow for ChatGPT browser and tools without filesystem access.
- [README.md](README.md): Developer help doc (repo root) — what you can build with the kit, protocol choice, the stack picker, and Day-0 checklist.
- [Task brief (00)](hackathon-kit/00-brief.md): The "what we're building" spec for the AI's first context message.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Version history.
- [Migration v2 → v3](hackathon-kit/MIGRATION-v2-to-v3.md): For anyone with a working OIDC-only v2 build.

## Numbered prompts (execute in order)

- [01 — Project skeleton](hackathon-kit/01-project-skeleton.md): Stack scaffold, env config, session adapter, logger, refresh-token storage guidance.
- [02 — User login](hackathon-kit/02-user-login.md): Branched. OIDC: Authorization Code + PKCE S256, state + nonce, `offline_access`. SAML: SP-initiated SSO, RelayState/InResponseTo/audience checks, then Step 0b (`saml2` → `refresh_token`).
- [03 — Token exchange](hackathon-kit/03-token-exchange.md): RFC 8693 token-exchange from the refresh token to an ID-JAG, then RFC 7523 jwt-bearer to an access token. Path-neutral.
- [04 — Protected resource call](hackathon-kit/04-protected-resource-call.md): Bearer call + WWW-Authenticate decoding + ErrorCode mapping + the re-mint-vs-re-authenticate rule.
- [05 — UI and observability](hackathon-kit/05-ui-and-observability.md): Dashboard, redacted token surface, `sub`/`sub_id` rendering, request timeline.
- [06 — Debugging playbook](hackathon-kit/06-debugging-playbook.md): Nineteen failure shapes with diagnostic prompts, marked by path (reference, not a step).
- [07 — Testing](hackathon-kit/07-testing.md): Hermetic rows + 9 smoke probes + E1–E7 manual scenarios.

## Reference

- [Glossary](hackathon-kit/reference/glossary.md): Terminology anchors — identities, tokens, wire-format pieces, OIDC and SAML machinery side by side, XAA-specific terms.
- [Env vars](hackathon-kit/reference/env-vars.md): Fixed hosts, `XAA_PROTOCOL`, per-developer credentials, and the branched OIDC/SAML registration walkthrough.
- [XAA spec](hackathon-kit/reference/xaa-spec.md): Canonical wire format for every grant — exact form fields, discovery metadata, token lifetimes, ID-JAG structure, `sub`/`sub_id`.
- [Error mapping](hackathon-kit/reference/error-mapping.md): ErrorCode set + WWW-Authenticate + token-exchange decoding tables, and the two faces of `expired_token`.
- [Architecture](hackathon-kit/reference/architecture.md): Flow diagrams for both login paths, the convergence point, and the token lifecycle.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Auto-loaded by Codex / Cursor — invariants digest.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Auto-loaded by Claude Code — invariants digest.
- [.cursorrules](.cursorrules): Cursor project rules.
- [.env.example](.env.example): Env-var template — copy to `.env.local` and fill in.
